name: Aruba Cloud VPS
line: Rent a virtual server and manage its operating system and apps.

work.math: €2.49 a month before VAT. 100 GB of data sent out fits within the 2 TB monthly allowance.
€2.49 a month before VAT, plus a Starter IPv4 address option that is not priced. Capacity is 1 vCPU and 1 GB RAM.
